name: Markdown Notes
summary:
**Markdown Notes** is a fast, private markdown note app built for Meta Horizon OS.

Everything runs on-device - your notes are plain `.md` files. No account, no cloud, no tracking.

- Live markdown editor with a formatting toolbar
- Rich preview: headings, lists, task checklists, quotes, code, and inline styles
- Organize with folders, color labels, and pinned notes
- Instant search and flexible sorting
- Word, character, and reading-time stats
- Export all notes to `.zip` and share any note as `.md`
- Ligh
